configuration.timingMethod: Retrieval and event processing use System.nanoTime; enforcement uses response and commit Instants
configuration.percentileMethod: Nearest rank: sorted[ceil(p*n)-1]; standard deviation is population standard deviation
configuration.warmupPolicy: Warm-ups are identified in raw rows and excluded from all aggregates
configuration.eventOutcomePolicy: Duplicate revocation requests count as successfully handled and are separately counted
configuration.authorizationPolicy: Existing metadata filter, authorization service, and PermissionManager revocation behavior
configuration.cachePolicy: Existing cache revalidates each cached document before returning it
configuration.performanceScope: Simulated in-memory lexical retrieval; not real-world RAG, vector database, or LLM latency
